description: Spec defines the desired state of ReferenceGrant.

enabled.description: Whether to render this resource. Defaults to true.

additionalProperties.description: ReferenceGrantFrom describes trusted namespaces and kinds.

group.description:
Group is the group of the referent.
When empty, the Kubernetes core API group is inferred.

Support: Core

kind.description:
Kind is the kind of the referent. Although implementations may support
additional resources, the following types are part of the "Core"
support level for this field.

When used to permit a SecretObjectReference:

* Gateway

When used to permit a BackendObjectReference:

* GRPCRoute
* HTTPRoute
* TCPRoute
* TLSRoute
* UDPRoute

namespace.description:
Namespace is the namespace of the referent.

Support: Core

from.description:
From describes the trusted namespaces and kinds that can reference the
resources described in "To". Each entry in this list MUST be considered
to be an additional place that references can be valid from, or to put
this another way, entries MUST be combined using OR.

Support: Core

fullNameOverride.description: Replaces the entire computed resource name, ignoring the release name and id.

nameOverride.description: Replaces just the id part of the computed resource name (<Release.Name>-<id>).

namespace.description: metadata.namespace for this resource. Defaults to the release namespace.

additionalProperties.description:
ReferenceGrantTo describes what Kinds are allowed as targets of the
references.

group.description:
Group is the group of the referent.
When empty, the Kubernetes core API group is inferred.

Support: Core

kind.description:
Kind is the kind of the referent. Although implementations may support
additional resources, the following types are part of the "Core"
support level for this field:

* Secret when used to permit a SecretObjectReference
* Service when used to permit a BackendObjectReference

name.description:
Name is the name of the referent. When unspecified, this policy
refers to all resources of the specified Group and Kind in the local
namespace.

to.description:
To describes the resources that may be referenced by the resources
described in "From". Each entry in this list MUST be considered to be an
additional place that references can be valid to, or to put this another
way, entries MUST be combined using OR.

Support: Core
